comment.narrative:
Output 1: No Implementation plans for Somali Transition Plan exist. No monitoring mechanism in place for the implementation of the Somali Transition Plan
Output 2: No overview or assessment exists on women’s participation in the security sector. No policy exists to increase women working in the security forces
Output 3: Capacity assessments 2019 and 2021 that show % of capacity evaluation, IDCBPs, Spot checks, HACT assessments, Quarterly Reports and Individual reports illustrate existing capacity. Existing strategic plans (FGS level). No strategic plans exist at FMS level.

Output 1: All targeted oversight security institutions have costed implementation plans for the Somali Transition Plan. National and federal M&E framework is in place to measure progress towards implementing the Somali Transition Plan
Output 2: A comprehensive overview is available on women’s participation in the security sector. Policy developed to increase women´s participation in the security sector.
Output 3: Ministerial proficiency in 3 major key ministerial functions is enhanced (measured through perception as part of continuous capacity assessment). All ministries have longer term strategic plans that can inform future programming

As of project closure in March 2022:
Output 1: STP implementation plans have not been developed due to AMISOM transitioning into A TMIS which required a new CONOPS. The project however enabled coordination, including the SCC meetings between FGS and FMS that produced agreements on the revised STP with new benchmarks. Discussions are already under way on the formulation of the implementation plans and the M&E mechanisms which will be supported by DCAF in the next phase.
Output 2: Assessment was done and consultations were conducted with national stakeholders on the necessity to examine and restructure the systems in the security forces that would allow for promotion and inclusion of women in the security sector. Likewise, the inclusion of female parliamentarians in discussions around security raised awareness of the importance of women in FMS Parliament to be active in discussions around security.
Output 3: Ministerial Strategic plans near completion in 2 states (Puntland and SWS). Agreement to start in Jubaland. The focus of ministerial capacity was enhanced for community outreach, coordination and civilian oversight was the focus of SSR-IP. 3 FMS ministries increased community outreach. Civilian oversight capacity enhanced in 2 states (Jubaland, Galmudug)
